forum.title: Can't program the option bytes using CLI?
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello again @thansen ,

You forgot the **-ob**before SECWM1\_STRT=0x0 SECWM1\_END=0x0 SECWM2\_STRT=0x1f SECWM2\_END=0x0.
forum.content_text:

scraped_replies.html:
Hello @thansen ,
Can you try this command instead ?
> STM32_Programmer_CLI.exe -c port=SWD -ob TZEN=0xB4 -ob SECWM1_STRT=0x0 SECWM1_END=0x0 SECWM2_STRT=0x1f SECWM2_END=0x0 -ob displ
I have put the changes made to your command in bold.
scraped_replies.author: Kouthair
